notes.title: Patch Notes for the February 17th, 2025 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added missing objects back to fire calls near the airport

[*] Increased timer from 60 to 75, giving you 15 more seconds to complete each call

[*] Slightly increased default speed of the firetruck

[*] New water tank filled notification UI

[*] Achievements Menu Updated

[*] Added some more details around the map

[*] Added 6 new calls

[*] Removed Christmas decorations and updated main menu screen

[*] Removed clicking sound in main menu UI and replaced with hovering sound

[*] Using the SkipCall powerup no longer crashes the game (my bad)

[*] Crashing into obstacles at high rates of speed no longer crashes the game

[*] Updated UI for the abilities and you can now use 1, 2, 3 & 4 on keyboard to use your abilities
 
[*] Added nighttime map back into the game and updated the freeplay map
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for the December 15th, 2024 BIG Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] This has been the largest update since the game was released! I plan on fully releasing the game on February 9th, 2025 (Exactly 2 years after releasing in early access). That will come with another update with more scenarios, more items/upgrades and the finishing touches on certain parts of the game. Thank you to everyone for your patience as I have been developing this game in my free time.

[*] New official game logo, check it out in the main menu or the steam store!

[*] Huge behind the scenes update, lots of the code was refactored to be more efficient and makes it easier to add new scenarios and items in the future.

[*] Fires now have health bars, making it much easier to see if you're hitting the right spot. Health bars are green but turn red when the fire is down to 25% health. (Make sure you're aiming for the base of the fire)

[*] Fires now take a different amount of water to put out based on it's size. For now, it ranges from 200 hits for the basic fire up to 500 for the large fire with smoke. 

[*] Each call will now spawn a random fire type (ex: Basic Fire, Large Fire, Pillar Fire, Wall of Fire, etc...), so if you get a call at the same location back to back, chances are it will have a different fire type

[*] There is now a grace period of 5 seconds so it is no longer possible to immediately get a new call the second after extinguishing the previous one

[*] New loading screen has been added when moving from the main menu to the game and vice versa

[*] New main menu

[*] Updated settings menu

[*] Nitro boost trail particles should properly display now

[*] The strength of the upgrade-able breaks has been increased

[*] Nitrous boost has been adjusted to also increase in strength in addition to length with each upgrade

[*] Some audio levels were adjusted

[*] You are no longer able to drive after failing the mission, score is also disabled after failing the mission

[*] Updated call completed graphic, now in the top left with a nice animation

[*] Added water spraying sound effect when operating the deck gun

[*] You can now use tab to quickly open and close the upgrade menu

[*] Temporarily removed night time map

[*] Added a Christmas tree to the fire station
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for the April 6th, 2024 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] BIG performance update! You will no longer go down to 15fps while viewing the whole map from the highway. Also, the graphics settings will now work properly. Rather than using a drop down menu, you can now just press the button of the quality setting you'd like to use and it will automatically update your graphics (you can only change it while in a game).
[*] UI elements now scale with screen size properly
[*] Replaced the "Water Bullets" with an actual water stream using particles.
[*] Moved the deck gun camera up a little bit so you're above the stream rather than at the base of it.
[*] Lights! The firetruck now has better and brighter emergency lights!
[*] The timer was not starting up again after using the freeze time power-up, that has been fixed.
[*] NEXT update will include health bars above each fire so that it's easier to tell if you're hitting it.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for the December 7th, 2023 Update
notes.content:
- Achievements are now achievable! There are currently 7 achievements that are possible:
"Water You Doing?", "Maximum Speed", "Give Me a Brake", "Wasting Water", "Rookie", 
"Probationary" and "Career". Descriptions on how to receive them are provided on steam.
There are 3 other achievements that may show up but they are still being worked on at the
moment.

- There is a new "Freeplay" mode where the timer is disabled so you can practice and
take as long as you need to get from call to call. 

- There are now particles that shoot out while operating the deck gun

- Various visual updates in the menus

notes.title: Patch Notes for the August 1, 2023 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Items are now available in the shop! You can pause time for a short duration, give yourself more time, give yourself a nitrous boost instantly or skip the current call all for a price. You can also purchase a money multiplier, which when bought will start generating $2 every 10 seconds.

[*] Fixed glitch where the truck would sometimes glide on its own when off-road  

[*] Timer turns red & the text becomes larger when down to your last 5 seconds to make it more noticeable when you're almost out of time

[*] Revised Tutorial level

[*] The "Reset Truck" label has been changed from an "R" to 2 circling arrows

[*] Added Graphics Settings

[*] Added the night time variation of the map back to the level selection page

[*] Various performance improvements
[/list]
